roots.origin: 古法语 taillier（切、裁开），源自晚期拉丁语 taliare
roots.core_concept: to cut into a measured piece / 按需要切出一块
roots.core_image: 剪刀沿着画好的线落下，把整块布裁成所需的小块

roots.origin: 拉丁语 sedere（坐）；相关形式 subsidere（坐下、留作后备）
roots.core_concept: to sit, settle, or remain in position / 坐下并留在一个位置
roots.core_image: 一个人走到指定座位坐下，位置从此稳定下来

roots.origin: 拉丁语 referre（带回、报告）；过去分词 relatus
roots.core_concept: to carry something back into connection / 把一件事带回另一件事旁边
roots.core_image: 两张分开的卡片被拿到一起，用一根线连起来比较

roots.origin: 希腊语 prassein（做、实行），其形容词 praktikos 表示适合行动的
roots.core_concept: to do something in actual action / 把想法真正做出来
roots.core_image: 图纸放在一边，双手开始按步骤把零件装成实物
roots.english_definition: to do, act, put into practice

roots.origin: 希腊语 physis（自然、生长出来的本性），来自 phyein（生长）
roots.core_concept: the nature that grows into being / 自然生长并呈现出的本性
roots.core_image: 种子自己破土长成植株，显出它内在的结构和规律

roots.origin: 晚期拉丁语 passare（迈步、经过），与拉丁语 passus（步）相关
roots.core_concept: to take a step and go beyond / 迈步经过并越到另一边
roots.core_image: 一只脚跨过门槛，身体从这一边移动到另一边

roots.origin: 希腊语 historia（调查所得的知识、叙述），来自 histor（知情的见证者）
roots.core_concept: an inquiry turned into an account / 调查之后形成的叙述记录
roots.core_image: 调查者收集证词和旧物，再按顺序写成一卷记录

roots.origin: 希腊语 elektron（琥珀）；琥珀摩擦后能吸引轻物，因而成为电现象名称来源
roots.core_concept: the attracting force observed in rubbed amber / 摩擦琥珀显出的吸引力
roots.core_image: 一块琥珀在布上摩擦后，把桌面的细小羽毛吸了起来

roots.origin: 希腊语 oikonomia：oikos（家、 household）+ nomos（规则、管理）
roots.core_concept: managing limited resources as a household / 像管一个家一样安排有限资源
roots.core_image: 桌上只有一定的钱粮，管家把它们分配到吃住、工具和储备中

concepts.concept: to cut into a measured piece
concepts.core_image: 剪刀沿线把整块材料裁成所需的小块

concepts.concept: to sit and remain in position
concepts.core_image: 人走到指定座位坐下，稳定地留在那里
两张分开的卡片被拿到一起，用线连成一组
双手按步骤把图纸上的想法装成实物
种子破土长成植株，显出内在结构和规律
一只脚跨过门槛，从这一边移动到另一边

concepts.concept: an inquiry turned into an account
concepts.core_image: 调查者收集证词和旧物，再按顺序写成记录

concepts.concept: attraction and charge first seen in amber
concepts.core_image: 琥珀在布上摩擦后吸起桌面的细小羽毛
管家把有限的钱粮分配到日常需要和储备中

words.root_logic: de-（完全）+ taillier（切）→ 从整体中细细切出的部分
words.origin: 古法语 detail：de- + taillier（切开）
words.native_definition: a small individual part of a larger whole
words.core_concept: a small piece cut out for close attention – 从整体中切出来单独细看的小部分
words.core_image: 一幅大图被放大，其中一小角显出细密纹路
examples: The report includes every important detail.
She described the scene in detail.
semantic_expansions: 细节/详情：从整体中切出并单独查看的小部分
详述（动词）：把整体切成小部分逐项说清

words.root_logic: en-（使进入）+ taillier（切、刻）→ 把条件刻进安排里，使其必然随附
words.origin: 古法语 entaillier（刻入）；法律义先指以限定方式安排地产，后泛化为必然包含
words.native_definition: to make something necessary or to involve it as a consequence
words.core_concept: having a condition cut into an arrangement so it must come with it – 条件被刻进安排，无法单独拿掉
words.core_image: 合同边缘刻着一道条件，签下主体也同时带上它
examples: The job entails frequent travel.
Repairing the roof will entail considerable expense.
semantic_expansions: 使必要/必然包含：条件已经刻进安排，接受主体就必须连带接受它
牵涉：某事随主要行动一并被带进来

words.root_logic: re-（再次、分回）+ taillier（切）→ 从大宗货物中再切成小份出售
words.origin: 古法语 retaillier（切下一块）；retail 原指零切出售
words.native_definition: the sale of goods to the public in small quantities
words.core_concept: cutting bulk goods into portions for individual buyers – 把大宗货切成个人能买的小份
words.core_image: 一整卷布在柜台上按顾客需要一段段剪下
examples: The company sells its products at retail.
Online retail has grown rapidly.
semantic_expansions: 零售：把大宗货物分切成面向个人的小份
零售业/零售的：围绕这种分份出售形成的行业或属性

words.root_logic: taillier（切、裁）+ 人称后缀 → 按尺寸裁布的人
words.origin: 古法语 tailleur（裁切者），来自 taillier（切）
words.native_definition: a person who makes fitted clothes, or to adapt something for a purpose
words.core_concept: cutting material to fit one particular body or need – 按特定对象的尺寸裁出合身形状
words.core_image: 一双手沿着粉笔线下剪，让布片恰好贴合一个人的尺寸
examples: The tailor adjusted the jacket sleeves.
The course is tailored to beginners.
semantic_expansions: 裁缝：按人的尺寸裁布者
使适合：像裁衣一样按具体需要改造内容

words.root_logic: pre-（在前）+ sid（坐）+ -ent（人）→ 坐在众人前面主持的人
words.origin: 拉丁语 praesidens，praesidere（坐在前面、主持）的现在分词
words.native_definition: the elected head of a republic or the person in charge of an organization
words.core_concept: the person seated before a group to preside over it – 坐在众人前面主持事务的人
words.core_image: 会议桌前端有一个主位，坐在那里的人主持全场
examples: The president addressed the nation.
She was elected president of the association.
semantic_expansions: 总统/主席/会长：都指坐在集体前面主持事务的人，中文按组织层级区分

words.root_logic: re-（留在、回到）+ sid（坐）+ -ence → 稳定坐落并居住的地方
words.origin: 拉丁语 residentia，来自 residere（留下、居住）
words.native_definition: the place where someone lives, especially officially
words.core_concept: a place where someone settles and remains – 一个人坐定并长期留下的地方
words.core_image: 夜里一栋房子的窗户亮起，住户每天都回到这里
examples: The form asks for your place of residence.
The ambassador returned to the official residence.
semantic_expansions: 住所/官邸：人稳定居住的地点，官邸强调职务身份
居住：在某处坐定并持续留下的状态

words.root_logic: re-（留在）+ sid（坐）+ -ent（人）→ 在一个地方坐定并长期留下的人
words.origin: 拉丁语 residens，residere（留下、居住）的现在分词
words.native_definition: a person who lives in a particular place, or staying in a place
words.core_concept: someone settled in a particular place – 在某地坐定并长期留下的人
words.core_image: 公寓门口的一排信箱写着长期住在这里的人的名字
examples: Local residents opposed the plan.
She is resident in London.
semantic_expansions: 居民/住户：在某地稳定留下的人
居住的：说明某人或事物固定留在该处

words.root_logic: sub-（在后、在下）+ sid（坐）→ 坐在后方待命的后备力量 → 支援款项
words.origin: 拉丁语 subsidium（后备部队、援助），来自 subsidere（坐在后方待命）
words.native_definition: money given by a government or organization to support an activity
words.core_concept: support kept sitting in reserve behind an activity – 留在后方、需要时托住事情的支援
words.core_image: 主力资金快见底时，后方一只储备钱袋被推到桌前
examples: Farmers receive a government subsidy.
The museum depends on public subsidies.
semantic_expansions: 补贴/津贴/补助金：都是后方拨出的支援资金，中文按对象和制度区分

words.root_logic: cor-（共同）+ relate（带入联系）→ 把两项共同带到一条线上比较
words.origin: 现代拉丁语 correlatio：com-（共同）+ relatio（关联）
words.native_definition: to show or have a mutual relationship
words.core_concept: bringing two changing things onto the same line – 把两个变化项带到一起看它们是否同步
words.core_image: 两条数据曲线叠在同一张图上，一起升降
examples: Income tends to correlate with education.
Researchers correlated the two sets of data.
semantic_expansions: 相关/使相互关联：把两项带到同一条线上寻找共同变化
关联物：在这条联系中与另一项对应的事物

words.root_logic: re-（带回）+ lat（ferre 的过去分词词干，带）→ 把一件事带回另一件事旁边 → 关联或讲述
words.origin: 拉丁语 relatus，referre（带回、报告）的过去分词
words.native_definition: to connect things, tell an account, or understand someone's experience
words.core_concept: carrying one thing back beside another – 把一件事带到另一件事旁边形成联系
words.core_image: 说话者把过去发生的事一件件带回听众面前
examples: The study relates diet to health.
She related the whole incident to the police.
Many readers can relate to the character.
semantic_expansions: 联系：把两件事带到一起
讲述：把过去的事情带回听者面前
理解并认同：把别人的经历带回自己的经验旁边比较

words.root_logic: relate（带到一起）+ -ion → 两件事被带到一起后形成的联系
words.origin: 拉丁语 relatio（带回、报告、联系），来自 referre
words.native_definition: a connection between people, groups, or things
words.core_concept: the connection formed by bringing things together – 事物被带到一起后形成的那条联系
words.core_image: 两座分开的岛之间架起一座桥，双方因此相连
examples: The relation between the two variables is unclear.
Diplomatic relations have improved.
semantic_expansions: 关系/联系：事物被带到一起后形成的连接
亲属：由共同血缘把人带到一起的一类关系

words.root_logic: relation（联系）+ -ship（状态）→ 联系持续存在的状态与方式
words.origin: 英语 relation + -ship，relation 最终来自拉丁语 referre（带回）
words.native_definition: the way in which people or things are connected
words.core_concept: an ongoing state of connection – 一条联系持续存在并形成固定相处方式
words.core_image: 两个人之间的一根线经过长期往来变成稳定的纽带
examples: They have a close working relationship.
The chart shows the relationship between cost and quality.
semantic_expansions: 关系/关联：两方持续相连的方式
人际关系：这种持续连接发生在人与人之间

words.root_logic: pract（做）+ -ical（…的）→ 能拿来实际做、能解决现实问题的
words.origin: 希腊语 praktikos（适合行动的），来自 prassein（做）
words.native_definition: concerned with real situations and likely to work effectively
words.core_concept: suited to being done in the real world – 放到现实中能真正做成的
words.core_image: 方案从纸面搬到工作台，工具材料都刚好用得上
examples: We need a practical solution.
The course provides practical experience.
semantic_expansions: 实际的/实践的：着眼于真实行动而非纯理论
实用的：放进现实行动后确实能解决问题

words.root_logic: practical（实际可做的）+ -ly → 从实际操作看；进一步表示几乎已经如此
words.origin: 英语 practical + -ly；practical 最终来自希腊语 prassein（做）
words.native_definition: in a realistic way, or almost completely
words.core_concept: judged by what happens in actual action – 按真正做起来的结果判断
words.core_image: 进度条只剩细细一格，实际看已经等于完成
examples: Practically speaking, the plan is impossible.
The hall was practically empty.
semantic_expansions: 实际上/实用地：按现实行动而不是抽象说法判断
几乎：实际效果已经接近完整状态，只差极小一步

words.root_logic: pract（做）+ -ise（使、反复进行）→ 反复实际去做以形成能力
words.origin: 中古英语 practisen，来自古法语 practiser，最终源自希腊语 prassein（做）
words.native_definition: to do an activity repeatedly to improve, or to work in a profession
words.core_concept: doing an action repeatedly until it becomes reliable – 一遍遍实际去做直到熟练
words.core_image: 同一段旋律被每天重复弹奏，手指越来越顺
examples: She practises the piano every morning.
He practises law in Manchester.
semantic_expansions: 练习：反复实际去做以提高能力
实行：把原则落实为行动
从事职业：长期实际执行某种专业工作

words.root_logic: practise（实际从事）+ -er（人）→ 长期实际从事某项专业工作的人
words.origin: 英语 practitioner，来自 practise；最终源自希腊语 prassein（做）
words.native_definition: a person actively engaged in a profession or skilled practice
words.core_concept: a person who regularly carries out a skilled practice – 经常亲手执行专业工作的人
words.core_image: 诊室里的人不是只读理论，而是每天亲自处理真实病例
examples: The clinic needs an experienced medical practitioner.
She is a leading practitioner of the method.
semantic_expansions: 从业者/执业者：实际执行某种专业工作的人
实践者：把一种方法持续落实为行动的人

words.root_logic: phys（自然、身体）+ -ical（…的）→ 属于可观察自然或身体实体的
words.origin: 拉丁语 physicalis，来自希腊语 physikos（自然的），源于 physis（自然）
words.native_definition: relating to the body, material things, or the laws of nature
words.core_concept: belonging to material nature and the body – 属于可触摸的自然实体与身体
words.core_image: 手掌碰到石块，能感到它真实的重量和硬度
examples: Regular physical activity improves health.
The device suffered physical damage.
semantic_expansions: 身体的：指自然生长的身体实体
物质的：指可触摸和测量的自然实体
物理的：指这些实体遵循的自然规律

words.root_logic: physic（自然知识、医术）+ -ian（从业者）→ 研究并照料身体自然状态的人
words.origin: 中古英语 fisicien，来自古法语，最终源自希腊语 physis（自然）；中世纪 physic 兼指自然学与医术
words.native_definition: a medical doctor, especially one treating illness without surgery
words.core_concept: a specialist in the body's natural condition – 诊察身体状态并帮助其恢复的人
words.core_image: 医生观察脉搏、呼吸和体温，从身体迹象判断病情
examples: The physician examined the patient carefully.
Consult your physician before changing the dose.
semantic_expansions: 医师：研究并处理身体自然状态的专业人员
内科医生：现代语境中常特指主要用非外科方法治疗的人

words.root_logic: physics（自然规律之学）+ -ist（研究者）→ 研究物质与能量规律的人
words.origin: 英语 physicist，来自 physics；physics 最终源自希腊语 physis（自然）
words.native_definition: a scientist who studies matter, energy, and natural forces
words.core_concept: a researcher of the rules governing material nature – 寻找物质世界运行规律的人
words.core_image: 实验室里一束光穿过仪器，研究者记录它如何偏转
examples: The physicist developed a new model of matter.
Several physicists repeated the experiment.

words.root_logic: phys（自然）+ -ics（学科）→ 研究自然物质、能量与运动规律的学科
words.origin: 希腊语 ta physika（关于自然之事），来自 physis（自然）
words.native_definition: the science of matter, energy, motion, and forces
words.core_concept: the systematic study of material nature – 系统寻找物质自然如何运行
words.core_image: 小球沿斜面滚下，刻度和计时器把运动规律记录下来
examples: She studies physics at university.
The physics of flight is complex.
semantic_expansions: 物理学：系统研究物质与能量的自然规律
物理现象：某件事背后实际运行的那些规律

words.root_logic: com-（共同、环绕）+ pass（步）→ 绕着边界一步步走量 → 圈定范围与定向工具
words.origin: 中古英语 compas，来自古法语 compasser（丈量、绕行），与 passus（步）相关
words.native_definition: an instrument showing direction, or the range and limits of something
words.core_concept: pacing around a boundary to establish direction and range – 绕着范围走量以确定方向和界限
words.core_image: 人在空地绕一圈丈量边界，再用指针确认北方
examples: Use a compass to find north.
The issue lies beyond the compass of this study.
semantic_expansions: 指南针：帮助行路者确定该往哪一步走
圆规：绕中心划定圆形边界
范围：被绕行丈量后圈定的界限

words.root_logic: passare（迈步经过）→ 从一边走过界线到另一边
words.origin: 古法语 passer，来自晚期拉丁语 passare（迈步、经过）
words.native_definition: to move beyond a point, give something onward, or succeed in a test
words.core_concept: moving across a point and onward – 跨过一个位置继续向前
words.core_image: 接力棒越过两人之间的界线，被递到下一只手里
examples: We passed the station at noon.
She passed the exam.
Please pass the salt.
semantic_expansions: 经过：身体跨过一个地点
通过：跨过考试设下的标准线
传递：让物品越过人与人之间的界线

words.root_logic: pass（经过）+ -age（过程或结果）→ 经过某处的通道、过程或一段文字
words.recall_hint: 先抓住 pass 的‘跨过’：它既可以是供移动穿过的一段路径，也可以是时间推进的过程，还可以是阅读时从头走到尾的一段文字。
words.origin: 古法语 passage，来自 passer（经过）
words.native_definition: the act or route of passing, or a section of text
words.core_concept: a route or segment through which movement proceeds – 让移动穿过的一段路径
words.core_image: 墙中留出一条窄道，人可以从一个房间走到另一个房间
examples: A narrow passage led to the garden.
The passage of time changed the town.
Read the final passage carefully.
semantic_expansions: 通道：供人经过的路径
经过：跨越过程本身
段落：阅读时从头走到尾的一段文字

words.root_logic: sur-（越过、在上）+ pass（经过）→ 走过对方所在的位置 → 超过
words.origin: 古法语 surpasser：sur-（在上、越过）+ passer（经过）
words.native_definition: to do or be better or greater than someone or something
words.core_concept: passing beyond another person's level – 跨过对方所处的标线继续向前
words.core_image: 两名跑者并排时，其中一人再迈一步越到前面
examples: Sales surpassed all expectations.
Her latest work surpasses the earlier novel.
semantic_expansions: 超过/超越：跨过原有数量或水平线
胜过：跨过竞争者所在的位置

words.root_logic: histor(y)（调查记录）+ -ian（从事者）→ 研究并书写过去记录的人
words.origin: 英语 historian，来自 history；最终源自希腊语 historia（调查、叙述）
words.native_definition: a person who studies and writes about the past
words.core_concept: a person who investigates evidence and builds an account of the past – 查证材料并重建过去叙述的人
words.core_image: 书桌上摊着档案、旧信和地图，研究者逐项核对年代
examples: The historian examined newly opened archives.
Historians disagree about the cause of the war.
semantic_expansions: 历史学家/史学工作者：都指调查证据并组织过去叙述的人，中文按语境正式程度区分

words.root_logic: histor(y)（历史记录）+ -ic → 值得写进历史记录的 → 有历史重大意义的
words.origin: 英语 historic，来自 history；最终源自希腊语 historia
words.native_definition: important enough to be remembered in history
words.core_concept: important enough to enter the lasting account – 重要到会被写进长期记录
words.core_image: 签字笔落下的一刻，大批记者把这一事件记录下来
examples: The leaders signed a historic agreement.
It was a historic victory for the team.
semantic_expansions: 有历史意义的/历史性的：重要到会被后人持续记述；不是泛指任何过去的事物

words.root_logic: history（历史记录）+ -ical → 与过去记录或历史研究有关的
words.origin: 英语 historical，来自 history；最终源自希腊语 historia
words.native_definition: connected with the study or events of the past
words.core_concept: belonging to the evidence and account of the past – 属于过去材料与叙述范围的
words.core_image: 博物馆展柜里陈列旧地图，标签注明它来自哪个年代
examples: The novel is based on historical events.
We need to examine the historical evidence.
semantic_expansions: 历史的/有关历史的：泛指与过去事件或研究有关
史实的：强调叙述能够由历史材料支持；与 historic 的重大意义不同

words.root_logic: historia（调查、叙述）→ 对过去进行调查后形成的记录
words.origin: 希腊语 historia（调查所得的知识、叙述），经拉丁语和古法语进入英语
words.native_definition: the study and record of past events, or a person's previous experience
words.core_concept: an investigated account of what happened before – 对已经发生之事的查证与记述
words.core_image: 一卷时间轴把散落的旧事件按先后顺序连接起来
examples: She teaches modern European history.
The patient has a history of heart disease.
semantic_expansions: 历史/历史学：对过去事件的记录与系统研究
经历：某个人或事物过去发生过的事情记录

words.root_logic: electr（琥珀摩擦产生的电现象）+ -ic → 由电荷驱动或带电的
words.origin: 新拉丁语 electricus（像琥珀一样能吸引），来自希腊语 elektron（琥珀）
words.native_definition: using, producing, or charged with electricity
words.core_concept: driven by or carrying electric charge – 由电荷推动或自身带有电荷
words.core_image: 插头接通后，电流沿导线进入机器让它运转
examples: They bought an electric car.
The wire carries an electric current.
semantic_expansions: 电的/带电的：直接涉及电荷和电流
电动的：以电流作为运转动力

words.root_logic: electric（电的）+ -al（有关…的）→ 与电力系统、设备或电学有关的
words.origin: 英语 electric + -al；electric 最终来自希腊语 elektron（琥珀）
words.native_definition: relating to electricity, especially systems and equipment
words.core_concept: connected with systems that carry and use charge – 与传送和使用电流的系统有关
words.core_image: 墙内成束导线连接配电箱与各个插座
examples: The building needs extensive electrical repairs.
She studies electrical engineering.
semantic_expansions: 电气的/电力的：多指完整的供电系统和设备
有关电的：泛指与电现象或电学相关；electric 常直接修饰由电驱动的东西

words.root_logic: electric（电）+ -ian（专业人员）→ 安装和维修电力线路设备的人
words.origin: 英语 electrician，来自 electric；electric 最终来自希腊语 elektron（琥珀）
words.native_definition: a person trained to install and repair electrical systems
words.core_concept: a specialist who works directly with systems carrying current – 亲手处理电流线路与设备的人
words.core_image: 技术人员打开配电箱，用仪表逐根检查线路
examples: Call an electrician to inspect the wiring.
The electrician replaced the damaged cable.
semantic_expansions: 电工/电气技师：都指安装维修电力系统的人，后者更强调专业技术身份

words.root_logic: electric（电荷作用的）+ -ity（状态）→ 电荷存在、移动所形成的能量和现象
words.origin: 英语 electricity，来自 electric；electricus 原指琥珀摩擦后的吸引性质
words.native_definition: a form of energy resulting from charged particles, especially when flowing as current
words.core_concept: energy produced by the presence and movement of charge – 电荷存在和移动形成的能量
words.core_image: 开关闭合后，电荷沿导线流动，灯丝随即发亮
examples: The storm cut off the electricity.
Electricity flows through the cable.
semantic_expansions: 电/电力：可输送并驱动设备的电能
电学现象：电荷静止或移动时表现出的各种作用

words.root_logic: econom（管理资源）+ -ic → 与生产、分配和整体资源体系有关的
words.origin: 法语 économique，来自希腊语 oikonomikos；根源为 oikonomia（家政管理）
words.native_definition: relating to the production, distribution, and use of wealth and resources
words.core_concept: belonging to the system that organizes resources – 属于整个资源生产和分配体系的
words.core_image: 城市地图上，工厂、市场、家庭与资金流被线条连成一个系统
examples: The country faces serious economic problems.
Economic growth slowed this year.
semantic_expansions: 经济的/经济上的：涉及社会整体资源如何生产和分配
经济学的：涉及研究这套资源体系的学科

words.root_logic: econom（管理资源）+ -ical → 会精打细算、不浪费资源的
words.origin: 英语 economical，来自 economic；最终源自希腊语 oikonomia（家政管理）
words.native_definition: using money, time, or resources carefully without waste
words.core_concept: managing a limited supply with little waste – 把有限资源安排得够用而不浪费
words.core_image: 同样一箱燃料，这台机器安排得当，运行时间更长
examples: This small car is economical to run.
We need a more economical use of water.
semantic_expansions: 节约的/省耗的：管理资源时尽量减少浪费
经济实惠的：花费与所得安排得划算；不同于 economic 的宏观经济含义

words.root_logic: econom（管理资源）+ -ics（学科）→ 研究稀缺资源如何生产、分配和使用的学科
words.origin: 英语 economics，来自 economy；最终源自希腊语 oikonomia（家政管理）
words.native_definition: the study of how resources, goods, and services are produced and distributed
words.core_concept: the systematic study of allocating limited resources – 系统研究有限资源如何安排
words.core_image: 黑板上一边写有限预算，一边画出家庭、企业和政府之间的流动箭头
examples: She studied economics at university.
The economics of the project remain uncertain.
semantic_expansions: 经济学：研究资源生产与分配的学科
经济状况（the economics of）：某个项目的成本收益结构

words.root_logic: oiko-（家）+ nom-（管理规则）→ 原指管理一个家，后扩大为管理社会资源的整体体系
words.origin: 希腊语 oikonomia（家政管理），由 oikos（家）+ nomos（规则、管理）构成
words.native_definition: the system by which a society organizes production and resources, or careful use without waste
words.core_concept: an organized household enlarged to society – 把整个社会的资源像一个家一样安排
words.core_image: 一个巨大的家庭账本里同时记录生产、交易、收入和支出
examples: Tourism is vital to the local economy.
We must achieve greater economy in fuel use.
semantic_expansions: 经济/经济体：社会范围内组织生产和分配资源的整体
节约：回到家政管理本义，谨慎安排有限资源避免浪费
